add-png-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add PNG Image to PDF Page Using PdfFileMend
add-png-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates binding an existing PDF with PdfFileMend, inserting a PNG image onto page two at specified coordinates, and saving the modified document.

replace-jpeg-with-bmp-first-page.title: Replace JPEG Image on First Page with High‑Resolution BMP
replace-jpeg-with-bmp-first-page.description: Demonstrates how to replace the first JPEG image on page 1 of a PDF with a higher‑resolution BMP using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor.

overlay-semi-transparent-gif-on-pdf.title: Overlay Semi-Transparent GIF on PDF Page
overlay-semi-transparent-gif-on-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent GIF over an existing PNG in a PDF by using an ImageStamp with opacity settings.

add-wrapped-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Word‑by‑Word Wrapped Footer to PDF Pages
add-wrapped-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add a footer with word‑by‑word wrapping to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment and rectangle settings.

add-promotional-text-to-specific-pdf-pag.title: Add Promotional Text to Multiple PDF Pages
add-promotional-text-to-specific-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates inserting the same promotional message on pages 3, 5, and 7 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AddText with an array of page numbers.

add-multi-line-text-block-page-3.title: Add Multi-Line Text with Custom Line Spacing to Page 3
add-multi-line-text-block-page-3.description: Demonstrates how to insert a multi-line text fragment with a specific line spacing into the left margin of the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-and-text-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Image and Semi‑Transparent Text Watermark to PDF
add-image-and-text-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place an image stamp as a background and overlay it with a semi‑transparent text stamp on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-png-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Image to All PDF Pages
add-background-png-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, loop through each page, and insert a PNG image that covers the whole page as a background.

add-header-image-to-pdf-documents.title: Add Header Image to PDF Pages
add-header-image-to-pdf-documents.description: Shows how to load PDF files with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp for a header image, apply the stamp to every page, and save the modified documents.

batch-add-company-logo-to-pdfs.title: Add Company Logo Image Stamp to PDF Pages
batch-add-company-logo-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to load each PDF in a folder, place a PNG logo as an ImageStamp in the top‑right corner of every page, and save the modified files to an output directory.

insert-png-signature-image-on-every-pdf-.title: Insert PNG Signature on Every PDF Page
insert-png-signature-image-on-every-pdf-.description: Shows how to add a PNG signature image to the bottom‑left corner of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and Document APIs.

add-tiff-image-to-last-page-pdf.title: Add TIFF Image to the Last Page of a PDF
add-tiff-image-to-last-page-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileMend to bind an existing PDF, add a TIFF image to its final page, and save the result without modifying existing content.

add-image-to-each-pdf-page-dynamic-posit.title: Dynamic Image Placement on PDF Page
add-image-to-each-pdf-page-dynamic-posit.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, retrieving page dimensions, calculating coordinates, and adding an ImageStamp at the bottom‑right corner.

add-image-to-pdf-with-format-validation.title: Add Images to PDF with Extension Validation
add-image-to-pdf-with-format-validation.description: Demonstrates how to validate image file extensions (JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF) before inserting them into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, creating a page per image and saving the result.

add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend.title: Ensure PDF Changes Are Saved Using PdfFileMend and Try-Finally
add-image-to-pdf-using-pdffilemend.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileMend to modify a PDF and guarantee that changes are saved by calling Close() inside a try‑finally block.

add-images-to-pdf-with-error-handling.title: Add Images to PDF with Error Handling
add-images-to-pdf-with-error-handling.description: Demonstrates inserting multiple images into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while handling missing files and exceptions for problematic image streams.

add-image-and-text-to-pdf-with-audit-log.title: Add Image and Text to PDF with Audit Logging
add-image-and-text-to-pdf-with-audit-log.description: The example loads a PDF, inserts an image and a text fragment on the first page, logs each operation with a timestamp, page number, and file name, and then saves the modified PDF.

configure-word-wrapping-bywords-add-long.title: Word‑by‑Word Text Wrapping in a PDF Rectangle
configure-word-wrapping-bywords-add-long.description: Demonstrates how to place a long paragraph inside a defined rectangle and enable word‑by‑word wrapping using Aspose.Pdf's TextFragment (requires a recent library version).

add-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Image to Specific PDF Page
add-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert an image onto a chosen PDF page at given coordinates using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and page stamping features.

async-add-image-to-pdf.title: Asynchronously Add Text Stamp to PDF
async-add-image-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a text stamp to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping the operation non‑blocking by wrapping the work in Task.Run.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.title: Extract Images from PDF to PNG
extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF document and save each image as an individual PNG file.

extract-images-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Images from Specific PDF Pages
extract-images-from-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to extract all images from pages 2 through 5 of a PDF and save them to a temporary directory using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

batch-extract-images-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Images from PDFs with Page and Index Naming
batch-extract-images-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to process all PDF files in a directory, extract each image per page using Aspose.Pdf, and save them with filenames that include the PDF name, page number, and image index.

remove-image-from-pdf-page.title: Remove Image by Object ID from PDF Page
remove-image-from-pdf-page.description: Shows how to delete a specific image from a PDF page using its object ID with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor.

remove-all-images-from-pdf.title: Remove All Images from a PDF
remove-all-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to delete every image in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified file to a new location.

replace-low-res-images-with-high-res-png.title: Replace Low‑Resolution Images with High‑Resolution PNGs
replace-low-res-images-with-high-res-png.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all images in a PDF and replace each low‑resolution image with a corresponding high‑resolution PNG using Aspose.Pdf and the PdfContentEditor facade.

add-text-at-coordinates-verify-position.title: Verify Text Position in PDF with Aspose
add-text-at-coordinates-verify-position.description: Creates a PDF in memory, adds a text fragment at specific X and Y coordinates, and uses a unit test with TextFragmentAbsorber to confirm the fragment’s position.

add-image-verify-pdf-byte-size.title: Verify PDF Size Increases After Adding Image
add-image-verify-pdf-byte-size.description: Creates a simple PDF, adds a PNG image as an ImageStamp, and asserts that the PDF byte size grows after the modification.

add-image-to-pdf-and-stream.title: Add Image to PDF and Stream via HTTP
add-image-to-pdf-and-stream.description: Loads a PDF, places an image on the first page using an ImageStamp, saves the modified document to a MemoryStream, and sends it to the client through an HTTP response.
